summary: Alamos Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 22, 2026, reporting exploration drilling results at its Island Gold Mine in Ontario. The press release describes high-grade gold mineralization extensions at the Island West Extension and Island West up-plunge zones, and at past-producing Cline-Pick and Edwards mines. The results are presented as potential sources of higher-grade mill feed for the expanded Magino mill. No corporate transaction, shareholder vote, or structural change is announced. The filing is a routine operational update for a mining issuer, not a special situation.
